title: The Day the Colors Ran Away
author: Hamidreza Rostami
moral_lesson: Notice and appreciate the beauty around you, because it is a gift.
short_description: One morning every color in the world disappears, and Milo sets out to bring them home.
long_description: One morning Milo wakes up and discovers that every color in the world has disappeared. Everything is gray, even his favorite red pajamas. So Milo sets out to find the colors, and discovers that they simply wanted a day off — being a color is hard work, and nobody appreciates them. Milo promises to notice them every single day, and the colors come flooding back. A warm story about noticing the beauty around us, and never taking it for granted.

art_direction.color_rule: Pages 2-19 place a fully saturated color world against a completely grayscale environment. The grayscale world is total; only the color-people and, from page 18, the returning color carry hue.
art_direction.pages_3_to_13: Entire world grayscale except the faint warm tint of the family's skin and hair.
art_direction.pages_14_to_17: Environment stays grayscale; only Red (page 14-17) carries saturated red.
art_direction.page_18: Environment grayscale; Blue, Green, Yellow and Red saturated.
art_direction.page_19: Environment grayscale; all four color-people saturated.

visual_style: High-quality 3D animated children's illustration (cinematic children's animation), soft painterly storybook rendering, strong grayscale-versus-color contrast, warm volumetric light

main_characters.name: Milo
main_characters.description: A cute 5-year-old boy with warm brown skin, big round dark eyes, rosy cheeks, and very curly messy dark brown hair with tight voluminous curls. Wears a red t-shirt and blue shorts in the color world, gray clothes in the gray world.

main_characters.name: Red
main_characters.description: A small round cheerful figure entirely in brilliant saturated red, with rosy darker-red cheeks, big bright eyes and a simple little red dress.

main_characters.name: Blue
main_characters.description: A small round figure entirely in brilliant saturated blue with droopy relaxed eyes.

main_characters.name: Green
main_characters.description: A small round figure entirely in fresh saturated green, always holding a book.

main_characters.name: Yellow
main_characters.description: A small round figure entirely in sunny saturated yellow, always with a snack.
main_characters.personality: Cheerful, dramatic, a little grumpy about gray food

emotional_journey: Joy -> Confusion -> Worry -> Determination -> Discovery -> Gratitude
text_rendering: All story text, title, blurb, and credit are embedded directly inside the AI-generated artwork images. No code-rendered typography.
pdf_assembly: Python (Pillow) used only to combine finished AI page images into one PDF.
